name: Root tessl.json targets Claude Code and the Tessl agent
instruction: The repository's tessl.json lists both claude-code and tessl-agent in agents.
relevant_when: The file is the repository-root tessl.json manifest.
context: The plugin collection is used interactively from Claude Code and by the Tessl factory, so installs must generate context for both agents.
scope_reason: tessl.json alone holds the agents field.

checklist.name: required-agents
checklist.rule: The top-level "agents" array contains both the string "claude-code" and the string "tessl-agent".
